ns2:course.label: Italian Culture and Globalization
ns2:course.description: Introduction to factors that have shaped present-day Italy, with particular attention to globalization; basic concepts contributing to understanding its present social and cultural development in a European and global context; taught in Italian. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ITAL 200 or ITAL 220, or consent of instructor.
